Five players have scored 5 goals in a single Premier League match, sharing the record [d4][d7]. According to ESPN and Opta Analyst, those players are: Andy Cole (Manchester United 9-0 Ipswich Town, 4 March 1995), Alan Shearer (Newcastle 8-0 Sheffield Wednesday, 19 September 1999), Jermain Defoe (Tottenham Hotspur 9-1 Wigan Athletic, 2009-10), Dimitar Berbatov (Manchester United 7-1 Blackburn Rovers, 2010-11), and Sergio Aguero (Manchester City 6-1 Newcastle United, 3 October 2015) [d4][d3]. Andy Cole was the first to achieve the feat, becoming the first player to score five goals in a single Premier League game at Old Trafford in March 1995 [d3][d9]. Alan Shearer then became the second player to do so, scoring five goals — including two penalties — in Newcastle's 8-0 demolition of Sheffield Wednesday at St. James' Park in September 1999 [d9][d8][d2].
